1. (Currently amended) A method for treating an ocular condition, the method comprising: administering to the interior of an eye a composition comprising a therapeutically effective amount of a macromolecular anti-angiogenic component (MAAC) to a mammal suffering from an ocular condition, wherein the composition also comprises a viscosity inducing component in an amount effective to increase the viscosity of the composition to a viscosity at about 25°C of __at least__ [[at least about]] __10__ cps at a shear rate of about 0.1/second, wherein said viscosity inducing component is injectable into the vitreous of a mammalian eye without permanently diminishing visual acuity, __wherein said MAAC comprises a polypeptide angiogenesis inhibitor, wherein said viscosity inducing component comprises hyaluronic acid, wherein said ocular condition comprises macular degeneration, and wherein said composition is administered to the posterior segment of the eye__.
